records.academicNote: Bachelor or equivalent, with preparation in linear algebra, calculus, probability, introductory statistics and computer programming. Preparation is assessed from evidence, not inferred from a degree title. A qualifying examination, test or interview may be required. GRE/GMAT and references are not mandatory; CV and personal statement are optional in the current FAQ. Supporting documents are due within four weeks of account creation or the clearing deadline, whichever is earlier; the account-creation date is not captured. The old FAQ July 2025 results date is not a 2027 application cutoff. July 2029 conferment is distinct from the 1.5-year normative study period. This Science AI award is separate from CS Delta X AI.

Bachelor in Engineering or Science, or an assessed equivalent qualification. A qualifying examination may be required. Current 2027/28 fee and entry sections establish PART-TIME only; the full-time portal section says To Be Updated and is not a selectable offer. CV, transcripts, grading information and CGPA proof are documentary requirements, not a numeric GPA cutoff. The official PDF introduces September 2027 but its fee heading and results date retain 2026/27 and July 2026; current department 2027/28 part-time fee evidence is used instead. The around-October opening statement is not an exact opening date.

Bachelor or equivalent AND at least one university or post-secondary certificate course in EACH of: calculus and algebra, computer programming, and introductory statistics, or related areas. Course equivalence and any qualifying examination require assessment; a major alone cannot prove all prerequisite courses. FT normative 1.5 years and PT 2.5 years are distinct from July 2029/2030 conferment. The 72-credit curriculum includes a capstone; it is a taught degree. The 2026/27 admission numbers and optional Delta X opportunity are not 2027 quotas or compulsory ordinary-path Shanghai study. Early October is an approximate opening statement. Broken homepage admission counters and unrelated footer links are excluded; key facts are corroborated against the HKU portal and October 2026 admissions PDF.

Bachelor or equivalent; a qualifying examination may be required. No exclusive computing/business undergraduate subject list or numeric GPA is established in the consulted entry sections. CV, transcripts and CGPA proof do not create a minimum CGPA. The 72-credit taught programme includes a capstone project or practicum. A generic now-open statement does not establish an exact opening date. Older optional Delta X Fellowship material is not imposed as a compulsory Shanghai semester on this ordinary Hong Kong offer.

Bachelor or equivalent AND knowledge of matrices and calculus, introductory statistics and linear modelling. Knowledge and any qualifying examination are assessed from evidence; a major alone does not establish all prerequisites. No fixed work-year gate, exclusive major list or numeric GPA is established. Risk Management, Data Analytics and Financial Statistics themes remain one degree. Normal FT 1-year/PT 2-year study is distinct from July 2028/2029 conferment or later conferment after summer assessment; these are not additional intakes. Older FTSS subsidy cohorts do not establish a 2027 automatic fee discount.
